review.gallery: Nine source-verified commercial tower renders. Gallery, card, and editorial scenes belong to the Sheikh Zayed Road office tower. The similarly named Maritime City project was excluded.
review.location: Regional diagram and 12 identified travel estimates verified on brochure page 5. JRE, Dubainary and DXB Residence agree on the vicinity point, consistent with the developer’s Al Sufouh map listing. Unnamed travel stops were omitted.
review.floorPlans: 25 full sheets from the original 28-page Danube commercial plan book on Jiwak, comprising 16 office layouts, three office plates and six amenity levels. Every office total was visually verified. The full source and printed notices remain available.

unavailable: The current office-specific drawing and exact entrance were not established. Danube website asset redistribution requires separate permission.
